    What stays enforced

    IDENTITY

    Credentials bind the caller to a principal. Tool arguments cannot choose an identity.

    DELEGATION

    Child authority stays within its parent: actions, resources, budget, expiry, and delegation depth.

    EXECUTION

    Every side effect rechecks the live grant chain. Atomic reservations protect shared budgets and quota.

    RECOVERY

    Idempotency prevents duplicate execution. Uncertain effects keep their reservation until trusted reconciliation.

    [ ]

    A permission check is advisory. The protected execution gateway checks again. A valid buyer grant cannot override the supplier’s own policy.
